subject: how to add different text in different panels using ggplot?

messages.author: 98c274df686b212f
messages.subject: how to add different text in different panels using ggplot?
parts:
I am comparing two distributions. Want to add the median values for
either group in the histogram. Anyone knows how?

Using the script below, on either histogram both median values show
up! But I want one at each plot!

all <- rbind(data.frame(Source=“group1", value = rnorm(100)),
data.frame(Source="group2", value=rnorm(100, 3,1))
med.x <- signif(aggregate(.~Source, data=all, function(x) median(x))
$value,3)
med.y <- aggregate(.~ Source, data=all, function(x) median(density(x)
$y))$value

g <- ggplot(all, aes(x=value)) + geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..),
fill="lightsteelblue") +
facet_grid(Source ~ .) + labs(x = x, y = "density") +
geom_density(adjust=1.5, size=1, linetype="longdash") +
geom_text(aes(x=med.x,y=med.y, label=med.x, groups=Source))
print(g)

Thanks!

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: how to add different text in different panels using ggplot?
parts:
Hi:

Try this:

library(ggplot2)
all <- data.frame(Source = rep(c('group1', 'group2'), each = 100),
value = rnorm(200, m = rep(c(0, 3), each = 100)))
medians <- ddply(all, .(Source), summarise, med.x = signif(median(value), 3),
med.y = signif(median(density(value)$y), 3))

facet_grid(Source ~ .) + labs(x = "x", y = "density") +
geom_text(data = medians, aes(x= med.x, y=med.y, label=med.x))
print(g)

HTH,
Dennis

It's not all that pretty, but you could add a new layer with vertical
lines at your medians.

g <- ggplot(all, aes(x=value)) +
geom_histogram(aes(y=..density..), fill="lightsteelblue") +
geom_density(adjust=1.5, size=1, linetype="longdash") +
facet_grid(Source ~ .) + labs(x = "x", y = "density") +
geom_text(data = medians, aes(x= med.x, y=med.y, label=med.x))
